name: reBEN: Refined BigEarthNet v2.0 Dataset for Remote Sensing Image Analysis
description: reBEN (Refined BigEarthNet v2.0) is a major revision and enhancement of the BigEarthNet remote sensing benchmark, created by TU Berlin and BIFOLD. It fixes geographical and spectral inconsistencies in Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 imagery, introduces high-resolution pixel-level land-cover segmentation maps, and provides standardized train, validation, and test splits across 549,488 European satellite image patches.
